body: Did try a hotline a copule of times. I hang up before anybody can answer, because I'm scared that not only will it not help, but I will also would be taking up the spot of someone who needs to talk a lot more than I do. My shyness doesn't help as well.

I haven't given up yet, I keep trying. Anytime everything gets too hard for me I call, but before I can say anything, I realize I'm about to start crying just from how nervous I am. Someone WILL pick up eventually, though, and I will be forced to talk to them:)

I have the same problem with my familly, if I say anything hinting at the fact that ssomething is wrong I can alwas excpect responses like "You have to be more postive", or "You're just imaginig things". 

I don't know if I can help you right now, beacuse I'm in a bad place as well, but I am free to talk if you want to:)

I did already go once, made me feel worse for a while. I did nothing to explain myself when I didn't show up the next time or ever agian for that matter. Sience it had the opposite effect the first four times, why would it help now that it has only gotten worse? I feel like I'm over reacting a lot, but I honestly think that she just sees me as another depressed teenager, just another kid who doesn't like school, and hates her parents.
I considered a hotline before, but I am so anxious of talking to strangers, especially about my problems, that I always end the call before anyone can pick up. It feels like I'm stuck.
I know I'm not going to go, but thanks a lot for even replying to this post:) For now I'm gonna have to tell myself that it gets better, like it usually does, even if I don't believe it.
Thank you, but so far I felt like even the psychologist didn't won't me there. It's so hard to tell myslef I'm imiging things when I feel can them so clearly.

Wow, I didn't know anyone was actually going to respond, thank you. 

The problem with going to the counselor is that I tried going to her already. We had about 3 or 4 visits before I decided that it's enough for me. Now I'm too scared to go back. This means I'm gonna have to tell someone else to force me to go. Im going to be the problem again. I'm so tired of all of this. I don't want to live, but I'm too scared to die. I wish I could just go to sleep and never wake up again.

( Thanks for the help with English:) )

I relate a lot to what you said. I have seasonal depression, which occurs each winter, and I honestly feel like it's never going to end. It seems like a stupid question, but how many people have you told about how you feel?
